nshm-knowledge-campus-durgapur-group-of-.description: NSHM Knowledge Campus Durgapur is a multi-disciplinary private campus whose Institute of Engineering and Technology offers MAKAUT-affiliated B.Tech programmes.
nshm-knowledge-campus-durgapur-group-of-.about: The Durgapur campus sits at Arrah near Muchipara and spans about 25 acres with hostel and sports facilities. Its engineering institute offers B.Tech programmes in computer science, electronics and communication, electrical engineering, and artificial intelligence and machine learning. These programmes are approved by AICTE and affiliated to Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology, West Bengal.
nshm-knowledge-campus-durgapur-group-of-.address: Arrah, Shibtala Via Muchipara, Durgapur, West Bengal 713212
nshm-knowledge-campus-durgapur-group-of-.affiliated_to: Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology, West Bengal

sanaka-educational-trust-s-group-of-inst.description: Sanaka Educational Trust's Group of Institutions is a professional education campus at Malandighi near Durgapur offering engineering, architecture and diploma programmes.
sanaka-educational-trust-s-group-of-inst.about: SETGOI is run by the Sanaka Educational Trust and is located at Malandighi in the Kanksa police station area of Durgapur. The campus houses an engineering institute, an architecture school and a diploma school. Its programmes are approved by AICTE.
sanaka-educational-trust-s-group-of-inst.address: Vill and PO Malandighi, PS Kanksa, Dist Burdwan, Durgapur, West Bengal 713212

university-institute-of-technology.description: University Institute of Technology, Burdwan is a professional engineering college run directly by the University of Burdwan at Golapbag in Purba Bardhaman.
university-institute-of-technology.about: The institute was set up in 2000 and is managed by the University of Burdwan. With approval from the Government of West Bengal and AICTE, it runs Bachelor of Engineering courses in six disciplines. It also offers postgraduate programmes.

bengal-institute-of-technology-and-manag.description: Bengal Institute of Technology and Management is an engineering and management college on the Sriniketan bypass near Santiniketan in Birbhum district.
bengal-institute-of-technology-and-manag.about: BITM began operating in 2001. Its campus is at Dwaranda on the Sriniketan bypass, next to Santiniketan. It offers undergraduate and postgraduate programmes in engineering and management.
bengal-institute-of-technology-and-manag.address: Sriniketan Bypass, PO Dwaranda, Santiniketan, West Bengal 731236

birbhum-institute-of-engineering-and-tec.description: Birbhum Institute of Engineering and Technology is an engineering college in Suri, the district headquarters of Birbhum, West Bengal.
birbhum-institute-of-engineering-and-tec.about: BIET started functioning in 1999 under the chairmanship of the educationist Professor Ramaranjan Mukherjee. It occupies a roughly 30 acre campus at Suri and was the first engineering institute in Birbhum. It is approved by AICTE, holds NBA accreditation for mechanical engineering, and took part in TEQIP-II.
birbhum-institute-of-engineering-and-tec.address: PO Suri, District Birbhum, West Bengal 731101

seacom-skills-university-school-of-engin.description: The School of Engineering of Seacom Skills University offers B.Tech programmes in mechanical, civil and electrical engineering at the university's campus in Birbhum district.
seacom-skills-university-school-of-engin.about: Seacom Skills University is a private university created by West Bengal Act VI of 2014 and recognised by UGC. Its campus is at Kendradangal near Bolpur in Birbhum district. The School of Engineering runs mechanical, civil and electrical engineering programmes.
seacom-skills-university-school-of-engin.address: Vill Kendradangal, PO Sattore, PS Panrui, District Birbhum, West Bengal 731236

cooch-behar-government-engineering-colle.description: Cooch Behar Government Engineering College is a Government of West Bengal engineering college at Harinchawra near Cooch Behar, established in 2016.
cooch-behar-government-engineering-colle.about: CGEC was set up in 2016 by the Government of West Bengal. It sits on its own 20 acre campus at Harinchawra, Ghughumari. The college is approved by AICTE and affiliated to Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology, West Bengal.
cooch-behar-government-engineering-colle.address: Harinchawra, PO Ghughumari, Dist Coochbehar, West Bengal 736170
cooch-behar-government-engineering-colle.affiliated_to: Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology, West Bengal

faculty-of-technology-uttar-banga-krishi.description: The Faculty of Technology of Uttar Banga Krishi Viswavidyalaya runs a four-year B.Tech programme in agricultural engineering at the university's Pundibari campus near Cooch Behar.
faculty-of-technology-uttar-banga-krishi.about: The faculty was introduced in 2005 with approval from AICTE and the Directorate of Technical Education, West Bengal. Its B.Tech in agricultural engineering applies engineering to crop production and natural resource use, with a focus on North Bengal. The university, based at Pundibari, began functioning in 2001.

darjeeling-hill-institute-of-technology-.description: Darjeeling Hill Institute of Technology and Management is an engineering college at Takdah in Darjeeling district, run in public-private partnership mode.
darjeeling-hill-institute-of-technology-.about: DHITM was established in 2024 by the Gorkhaland Territorial Administration and is managed by the Orissa Child Welfare and Education Trust. It describes itself as the first engineering college in West Bengal set up in PPP mode. It is approved by AICTE and affiliated to MAKAUT, and offers engineering, AI and hotel management programmes.
darjeeling-hill-institute-of-technology-.address: Takdah Cantt, Rungli Rungliot Block, District Darjeeling, West Bengal 734222
darjeeling-hill-institute-of-technology-.affiliated_to: Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology, West Bengal

siliguri-institute-of-technology.description: Siliguri Institute of Technology is a Techno India Group engineering college at Sukna on Hill Cart Road, near Siliguri in North Bengal.
siliguri-institute-of-technology.about: SIT was founded in 1999 under the Techno India Group. Its campus lies about 5 km from Siliguri, surrounded by tea gardens and the Sukna forests. The institute holds AICTE approval.
siliguri-institute-of-technology.address: Hill Cart Road, Sukna, Siliguri, Darjeeling, West Bengal 734009
